from PIL import Image
import numpy as np, cv2
from scipy.cluster.vq import kmeans2
im=np.array(Image.open('first_frame.png'))
h,w=im.shape[:2]
# quantile region stats
print('horizontal strips means')
for y0 in range(0,h,60): print(y0, im[y0:y0+60].mean((0,1)).round(1), im[y0:y0+60].std((0,1)).round(1))
# kmeans sample
small=cv2.resize(im,(80,45),interpolation=cv2.INTER_AREA)
pix=small.reshape(-1,3).astype(float)
cen,lab=kmeans2(pix,10,minit='++',iter=40,seed=3)
order=np.argsort(cen.mean(1)); rem={o:i for i,o in enumerate(order)}
chars=' .:-=+*#%@'
print('centers ordered')
for i,o in enumerate(order):print(chars[i],np.round(cen[o]).astype(int))
lab=np.vectorize(rem.get)(lab).reshape(45,80)
print('MAP')
for row in lab: print(''.join(chars[x] for x in row))
# HSV regions connected comps generous
hsv=cv2.cvtColor(im,cv2.COLOR_RGB2HSV)
regions={
'dark': ((im.max(2)<75)),
'black_sat': ((hsv[:,:,2]<95)&(hsv[:,:,1]<130)),
'red': (((hsv[:,:,0]<12)|(hsv[:,:,0]>172))&(hsv[:,:,1]>80)&(hsv[:,:,2]>70)),
'orange': ((hsv[:,:,0]>=8)&(hsv[:,:,0]<28)&(hsv[:,:,1]>80)&(hsv[:,:,2]>80)),
'yellow': ((hsv[:,:,0]>=20)&(hsv[:,:,0]<42)&(hsv[:,:,1]>60)&(hsv[:,:,2]>90)),
'green': ((hsv[:,:,0]>=35)&(hsv[:,:,0]<90)&(hsv[:,:,1]>55)&(hsv[:,:,2]>50)),
'blue': ((hsv[:,:,0]>=85)&(hsv[:,:,0]<135)&(hsv[:,:,1]>65)&(hsv[:,:,2]>45)),
'purple': ((hsv[:,:,0]>=130)&(hsv[:,:,0]<172)&(hsv[:,:,1]>55)&(hsv[:,:,2]>55)),
}
for name,mask in regions.items():
 n, labs, stats, cents=cv2.connectedComponentsWithStats(mask.astype('uint8'),8)
 ids=np.argsort(stats[1:,4])[::-1][:12]+1
 print('\\n',name,'total',mask.sum())
 for i in ids:
  x,y,ww,hh,a=stats[i];
  if a<40:continue
  print(' ',a,(x,y,ww,hh),'cent',np.round(cents[i],1))
# canny line detections
ed=cv2.Canny(cv2.cvtColor(im,cv2.COLOR_RGB2GRAY),70,150)
lines=cv2.HoughLinesP(ed,1,np.pi/180,threshold=70,minLineLength=45,maxLineGap=12)
print('\\nlines')
ls=[]
for q in lines[:,0]:
 x1,y1,x2,y2=q; length=np.hypot(x2-x1,y2-y1); ang=np.degrees(np.arctan2(y2-y1,x2-x1));ls.append((length,ang,tuple(q)))
for x in sorted(ls,reverse=True)[:60]:print(tuple(round(v,1) if isinstance(v,float) else v for v in x))
